ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels forming the base substrate with 15% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels concentrated in focal circular patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant distribution of high-contrast white annular rings (diameters ranging from 5 to 25 pixels) scattered across both lobes, with a higher spatial density on the mid-sections of the left lobe (viewer perspective) compared to the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 105 degrees; notch vertex is sharp and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; sharp peaks and shallow valleys (amplitude 3-10 pixels) distributed continuously along the trailing edge, with notable deeper indentations on the medial-right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature originating from the median notch and transitioning to a convex distal sweep towards the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular, high-contrast white rings (annular scars) globally distributed; significant clustering observed in the mid-lateral zones of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible near the base of the fluke where it meets the water line, primarily on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-intensity, calcified protrusions (sessile barnacles) are visible on the distal tips of both lobes and at irregular intervals along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The pigmentation pattern is uniquely defined by a 'ring-dominant' morphology rather than typical mottling or solid patches, likely representing high-density post-attachment scarring.
